In his adolescence, famed [[Snivvian/Legends|Snivvian]] con artist [[Marn Hierogryph]] had a '''tutor''' whom he framed for racketeering. After the tutor's conviction on evidence planted by Hierogryph, the young Snivvian's parents sent him away from his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Cadomai Prime/Legends|Cadomai Prime]].
